description: S34 T3's MC11 state: no MCP config file is the legitimate absence, not a refusal — present:false names the exact path mcp.status looked at, so a page can quote it rather than guess. The real loader (internal/mcp.LoadConfigFile) is all-or-nothing: there is no per-server refused field here, because a config that fails to load never produces a partial list of servers to report from.
